title: UPI fail hua, paisa kata? Bank roz ₹100 dega?
hooks: UPI fail, paisa kat gaya? RBI aapko ₹100 roz dega!
Payment failed, money deducted? Get ₹100 daily from the bank.
UPI transaction failed? RBI says you’ll earn ₹100 each day.
hook_why: Starts with the pain point and the ₹ amount in the first four words, matching the channel’s high‑performing hook pattern.
metaphor: A highway of payments where a stalled car (failed UPI) triggers a daily fine until it moves again.

scenes.title: Raghav

messages.text: Tension mat le, bank dega paise 😄

scenes.vo: UPI fail hua, aur paisa kat gaya? Bank aapko har din ₹100 dega.

scenes.title: RBI circular
lines: Dost ko bheja paisa: T+1 din mein wapas
Dukaan ka payment: T+5 din mein
Der hui: bank dega ₹100 har din
scenes.vo: Ye RBI ka niyam hai, 20 September 2019 se. Dost ko bheja paisa agle din tak wapas aana chahiye.

scenes.title: REFUND KAB TAK
scenes.vo: Dukaan ko kiya payment fail hua, toh paanch din tak.

scenes.title: Bank Credit
scenes.vo: Usse ek din bhi der hui, toh bank har din ₹100 khud dega. Claim nahi karna padta.

scenes.sub: Status: Failed? Toh paisa wapas aana hi hai
scenes.vo: Sabse pehle app khol, transaction status dekho.
Agar failed dikh raha, turant 'Raise Dispute' dabao.

messages.text: Rs 500.00 debited from a/c XX4821 to VPA aditya@okaxis. UPI Ref 4321 8765 1290.

scenes.vo: Reference number, screenshot, aur SMS sab save kar lo.

scenes.title: COMPLAINT
scenes.vo: Bank ne 30 din mein theek nahi kiya? RBI ke CMS portal pe complaint karo.

scenes.title: Refund Helpdesk

messages.text: Refund ke liye apna UPI PIN bhejiye

scenes.vo: Kabhi bhi PIN ya OTP kisi ko mat do.
Save karo, agle baar aise situation se bach jao!

caption:
UPI fail hua, paisa kata? Bank aapko har din ₹100 dega 💸
RBI ka niyam (circular, 20 Sep 2019): dost ko bheja paisa T+1 din mein, dukaan ka T+5 din mein wapas. Der hui toh bank har din ₹100 khud dega.
Bank 30 din mein theek na kare? cms.rbi.org.in pe complaint.
Source: RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67, 20 Sep 2019
Save karo, kaam aayega 📌
kiro_checked: 19 Nov: facts checked by hand against RBI/2019-20/67 (Mint, ET); bank pays, not RBI; ₹100/day after T+1 / T+5 | phone look 19 Nov
